On the street outside the policyholder's residence, Brightwater, OR

sections.heading: What happened (as stated by the policyholder)
sections.paragraph: Policyholder states the minivan was parked on the street in front of the residence at about 9:40 PM on 11/08. When the policyholder went out the next morning, the rear bumper was cracked and scuffed and one corner of the bumper was sitting lower than the other. No note was left and the policyholder does not know who hit the vehicle. Neighbors did not see anything. The policyholder did not report the incident to police. The policyholder came into the agency office to report the claim and will send photos from their phone.
